skill.name: calculator
skill.description: Evaluate arithmetic expressions with addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, powers, and parentheses.
skill.summary: Calculate basic and compound arithmetic expressions from natural prompts.
skill.author: AI Creator

security_audit.summary: The Python helper confirms a real high-risk pattern because it evaluates user-supplied expressions with eval. The current allowlist blocks direct imports, but it does not bound expression size or computational cost. All SKILL.md backtick findings are Markdown formatting false positives, and no prompt injection text was found.

remediation.suggestion: Replace eval with an AST-based arithmetic parser that only permits numeric literals and approved operators.
Add maximum input length, nesting depth, exponent size, and execution timeout before evaluating expressions.
Document that the helper is not hardened for untrusted inputs until eval is removed.

finding_verdicts.reason: calculator.py evaluates the caller-provided expression with eval after only character allowlisting. Direct imports are blocked, but unbounded arithmetic expressions can still create resource-exhaustion risk.

content.value_statement: Manual arithmetic checks slow down routine work. This skill evaluates basic and compound math expressions inside Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Evaluates addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division expressions.
Reports divide-by-zero and invalid character errors.
Provides example expressions in the skill documentation.
Includes a Python helper for local expression evaluation.
limitations: Does not support variables, functions, units, or symbolic algebra.
Uses Python eval internally and needs hardening before untrusted deployment.
Does not solve equations, graph results, or perform calculus.
Does not include precision controls for decimal rounding.

use_cases.title: Check Quick Arithmetic
use_cases.description: Operations teammates can calculate totals, differences, and ratios during routine work.

use_cases.title: Review Formula Results
use_cases.description: Analysts can verify simple expression results before sharing notes or reports.

use_cases.title: Test Math Examples
use_cases.description: Developers can confirm sample arithmetic outputs while documenting tools or lessons.

prompt_templates.title: Calculate a Simple Expression
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate 18 + 24 / 3 and show the final result.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Operation Order
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate (15 - 3) * 4 + 2 ** 3 and explain the operation order.

prompt_templates.title: Normalize Power Notation
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this expression to a calculator-friendly form, then evaluate it: 5 ^ 3 - (12 / 4).

prompt_templates.title: Audit Several Expressions
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these arithmetic expressions for invalid characters, divide-by-zero cases, and final results: 10/2, 8/(3-3), 2^10.

output_examples.output: The expression cannot be evaluated because division by zero is not allowed.

best_practices: Use parentheses when operation order must be clear.
Keep expressions short when running the current helper script.
Review results separately for financial or safety-critical decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not enter secrets, personal data, or private identifiers in expressions.
Do not use it for variables, functions, units, or symbolic algebra.
Do not run very large exponent expressions without resource limits.

faq.question: Can it run inside Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Which operations are supported?
faq.answer: It supports addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, powers, and parentheses.

faq.question: Does it support variables or functions?
faq.answer: No. The skill documentation says variables and function calls are not supported.

faq.question: Is the implementation safe for untrusted inputs?
faq.answer: Not yet. The helper uses eval and should be hardened before public untrusted use.

faq.question: Can it handle division by zero?
faq.answer: It returns an error for division by zero.

faq.question: Does it perform advanced math?
faq.answer: No. It is limited to arithmetic expression evaluation.
